Table-aware ingestion decreased recall@5 from 0.733 to 0.667 by introducing near-duplicate chunks that crowded the re-ranker.

Most RAG projects rely on qualitative impressions, but a golden-question evaluation harness is required to measure retrieval quality objectively. In testing, the initial 30-question set incorrectly suggested that re-ranker quality was the binding constraint. Doubling the evaluation set to 60 questions revealed that query rewriting was a more pressing need.

Retrieval performance is often hindered by technical artifacts. The pdfplumber tool frequently emits words welded together, which causes FTS5 to tokenize them as a single token. All-lowercase welds accounted for 1,971 / 2,144 (92%) of chunks containing a 16+ character weld. Implementing vocabulary-based re-spacing reduced the share of welded tokens from 10.2% to 5.4% and raised recall@5 from 0.683 to 0.767.

Aggregate metrics can be misleading when they contradict the retrieval hypothesis.
bodies.thread:
Table-aware ingestion decreased recall@5 from 0.733 to 0.667 because it introduced near-duplicate chunks that crowded the re-ranker.

Most RAG projects skip the golden-question evaluation harness, relying on qualitative impressions instead of measuring retrieval quality with numbers.

The system uses SQLite with the sqlite-vec extension for local, zero-infrastructure vector storage. The bge-small-en-v1.5 embedding model is local, 384-dimensional, and requires no API key.

Hybrid retrieval improved recall@5 from 0.500 to 0.733. Adding a re-ranker improved recall@5 from 0.467 to 0.500.

Increasing the re-rank pool from 20 to 50 candidates decreased recall@5 from 0.733 to 0.700 because the extra distractors cost more than the recovered answers.

All-lowercase welds accounted for 1,971 / 2,144 (92%) of chunks containing a 16+ character weld. Vocabulary-based re-spacing reduced the share of welded tokens from 10.2% to 5.4%.

Aggregate metrics can be misleading. A 30-question set incorrectly suggested re-ranker quality was the binding constraint, while a 60-question set revealed query rewriting was a more significant need.

A RAG system must include a golden-question evaluation harness to objectively measure retrieval quality rather than relying on qualitative impressions.
